final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS c2, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS c3 FROM film GROUP BY rating), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c3) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rating, s1.c2, s1.c3, s1.c3 - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c3 > s2.m) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(d) FROM s3
